page.layout: One block only: the spine of a bound volume, with a title in ink at the top and two paper labels lower down. No printed text block on this scan.
page.notes: The scan shows the binding of a book, not a printed page. The title at the top of the spine is in dark ink or stamped capitals, apparently "ROLLOCVS" on the first line, "IN" on the second and "IOHANNEM" on the third. The first word is uncertain: it may be "ROLLOCVS" or "HOLLOCVS" [?]. The two paper labels at the foot (a "U / 1721" label and an "Exegetica / 138." label) are library or shelf marks and are left out. No text block is visible.
